why_no_default_pilot: Extra finite samples alone cannot exclude an unbounded unknown tail. First seek a valid whole-wrapper range and a concrete decision gap. If unavailable, only a separately approved empirical study with predeclared source-based strata can strengthen an empirical claim; it does not certify a population upper.
